I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will make the land desolate, and all…
‘Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, “You were likened to a young lion of the…
No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.
Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue…

translations.web: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.
translations.bsb: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.
